subject: Shit To Do in NYC (Oct 19): Massano, a drag finale, and 55 miles on a bike
opener: Halloween week is next week, which means this is the last one where you can do something that isn't in a costume. Use it. Friday is a warehouse, Saturday runs from SoHo cobblestones to a 5am close, and Sunday you're either on a bike by 7am or you're not.

picks.headline: Massano takes Knockdown's main hall
picks.title: Massano, Konstantin Sibold, SOEL
picks.why: This is the Afterlife-adjacent end of melodic techno, the Rebūke and Tinlicker lane you actually live in. Big industrial room, real sound, nobody selling you a table. Konstantin Sibold and SOEL open, Massano plays late.
picks.heads_up: $43 all-in on Dice and resale is flagging it as nearly gone, so buy before Wednesday. Doors 10pm, 21+, Maspeth, so plan the car home.
picks.invite_text: Massano at Knockdown this Friday, melodic techno in the big room. Grabbing tickets tonight before it sells, you in?

verification.note: Dice blocked fetches; JamBase's event page states Fri Oct 23, 2026, 10:00 pm at Knockdown Center, 52-19 Flushing Ave, Queens (Maspeth) with Massano, Konstantin Sibold and Soel — date, time and venue match; the $32/$43 Dice price could not be read on any page.

picks.headline: Witches and Stitches crowns a winner
picks.title: Witches and Stitches 2026 Finale: Urban Legends
picks.why: A year-long drag and costume competition ending at All Night Skate, which you already love, on a Thursday, for ten bucks. Every monthly winner comes back to fight for it and the theme is urban legends. This is the night that bar's actual community shows up for, not a marketed drag brunch.
picks.heads_up: $10 suggested donation at the door, doors 8pm. Get there early, finale nights at that room fill up and seating is whatever you claim.
picks.invite_text: Thursday: the drag costume competition at All Night Skate is doing its big year-end finale, ten bucks at the door. Doors at 8, I'm going.

verification.note: Instagram would not load, but All Night Skate's own calendar (allnightskate.com event page, 54 Rockaway Ave, Brooklyn) lists Witches & Stitches on Thursday, October 22, 2026, 8:00 PM–11:30 PM; the $10 suggested donation is not stated on the venue page.

picks.headline: NYC Century: 55 miles, four boroughs
picks.title: NYC Century Bike Tour
picks.when: Sun Oct 25, rolling start from 6am, event runs to 6pm
picks.why: You rode to the GW Bridge with friends and talked about it for months. This is that ride with aid stations, 2,000 other people and a mileage option for whoever in the crew is soft. Take the 40 or 55 and you're showered and home by early afternoon.
picks.heads_up: $130 general, $205 VIP, register before Sunday. Rolling start from 6am and the event window runs to 6pm, so pick your route and start time now rather than at the line.
picks.invite_text: Sunday is the NYC Century bike tour, 40 or 55 mile options, rolling start early morning. Signing up tonight, come do the 55 with me.

verification.note: Transportation Alternatives' own event page shows NYC Century on Sunday, October 25, 2026, 6:00 AM–6:00 PM, and the Zeffy ticketing page lists General Admission $130 and VIP $205 (youth $60, rain insurance $15).

picks.headline: Company XIV's Petite Rouge, final two weeks
picks.title: Petite Rouge — Company XIV
picks.when: Thu Oct 22 to Sat Oct 31, Thu, Fri and Sat at 8pm; Sun at 6pm
picks.price: from $35 Thursday, from $39 Sunday, from $49 Friday and Saturday
picks.why: Your favorite room in the city, and this one closes October 31 before they flip the theater over to the Nutcracker. Baroque burlesque Little Red Riding Hood, cocktails at the table, 21+. Sunday at 6pm is the easy babysitter math; Thursday at 8pm is the standard date night.
picks.heads_up: Seats start around $35 Thursday, $39 Sunday and $49 Friday and Saturday, with couch and champagne upgrades on top. Listings disagree slightly on which nights are dark, so confirm the curtain time on their calendar before you book the sitter.
picks.invite_text: Company XIV's Little Red Riding Hood show closes Halloween. Want to do the Sunday 6pm with a sitter, or Thursday if you'd rather make a night of it?

verification.note: TodayTix's Petite Rouge page settled the date dispute: there is no Mon Oct 19 performance; upcoming shows are Thu Oct 22 8pm (from $35), Fri Oct 23 8pm ($49), Sat Oct 24 8pm ($49), Sun Oct 25 6pm ($39) at Théâtre XIV, 383 Troutman St — so Oct 22 is right, but Sunday is from $39, not $35, and the run ends Oct 31.

picks.headline: Ahmed Spins brings Afro house to Maspeth
picks.title: Ahmed Spins, Sapian, Mehdi
picks.when: Sat Oct 24 to Sun Oct 25, 11pm to 5am
picks.why: Johannesburg-raised, and this is the Afro house and amapiano end of the scene rather than a commercial Afrobeats club night with a dress code. Your current listening phase, played properly on a warehouse rig. If the crew wants a two-night weekend, this stacks with Friday.
picks.heads_up: 11pm to 5am, from about $38 on Dice. That's a genuine all-nighter, so pick your exit time in advance and sort the ride home. It runs until 5am, not 3am.
picks.invite_text: Saturday late: Ahmed Spins doing Afro house at Knockdown, doors 11 and it runs till 5. Warehouse, proper sound. Who's in?

verification.note: Dice pages would not load (the Dice venue list returned a stale 2023 cache); RA's event page ra.co/events/2508164 states Sat, Oct 24, 2026, 23:00–05:00 at Knockdown Center with Ahmed Spins, Sapian and Mehdi, 21+; the $38 price is not shown.

picks.headline: Cars and coffee on Greene Street cobblestones
picks.title: Cars & Coffee x Retromobile NYC
picks.venue: Greene Street (NYC Car Club x Retromobile NYC)
picks.why: This is the Daikoku-register thing, not a dealership lot with a banner. Three blocks of SoHo cobblestone, all makes, organizer rules say no revving and no racing because it's a hang. Nine to noon means you're done before the day starts.
picks.heads_up: Free, rain or shine, 9am to noon between Broome and Prince. Go early, the good cars leave first and parking down there is its own event.
picks.invite_text: Saturday morning there's a proper car meet on the cobblestones in SoHo, 9 to noon, free. Coffee first, then go look at engines?

verification.note: Eventbrite listing from NYC Car Club states Saturday, October 24, 2026, 9 AM–12 PM on Greene St in SoHo (90 Greene St), rain or shine, all ages, no ticket charge.

picks.headline: Schlingensief's Germany Trilogy, free at Goethe
picks.title: Repertory at Goethe: Christoph Schlingensief's Germany Trilogy
picks.when: Sat Oct 24, 3pm, full trilogy with an introduction
picks.why: Three reunification-era splatter films by the most unhinged German director of the era, screened back to back with an intro from the curator. Free, a hundred seats, and the kind of German programming you keep saying you want and never see listed anywhere. The German talk I had in here sold out, so this is the German slot now.
picks.heads_up: Saturday 3pm, free but registration is required and seating is first come first served. It's the full trilogy, so block the afternoon.
picks.invite_text: Saturday afternoon at the Goethe-Institut they're showing all three of Schlingensief's German reunification horror films, free with an intro. Weird and very German, want in?

verification.note: Read the Goethe-Institut New York events calendar and the event detail page (event_id=27364056): 'Repertory at Goethe: Germany Trilogy', Sat 10/24/2026, 3:00 PM-7:00 PM, Goethe-Institut New York, free admission with registration via a linked Eventbrite page, screening all three films (100 Years of Adolf Hitler, The German Chainsaw Massacre, Terror 2000); the page does not mention an on-stage introduction, but date, time, venue and price all match.

radar.headline: UFC 334 at the Garden, two title fights
radar.title: Polymarket UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit
radar.when: Sat Nov 14, ticket listings show a 5pm first bell for early prelims; the main card runs late evening
radar.why: Gane defending the heavyweight belt against an undefeated American, on a 13-fight card at MSG. It's the one big combat night in the city this fall and the exception to your no-Midtown rule.
radar.book_by: buy now, Garden UFC cards only get worse on resale

verification.note: UFC.com's official UFC 334 page states Sat, Nov 14, 2026 at Madison Square Garden with early prelims 5:00 PM, prelims 7:00 PM and main card 9:00 PM; MSG's page confirms the Nov 14 date and Gane vs Hokit main event.

radar.headline: Major League DJz, Halloween at Elsewhere
radar.title: Elsewhere Halloween: Major League DJz, SAIDAH, D Stone
radar.when: Sat Oct 31 to Sun Nov 1, 10:30pm, full venue
radar.why: The duo who exported amapiano worldwide, playing a costume night in Bushwick on Halloween itself. Your current phase and your dress-up-with-friends thing in a single booking.
radar.book_by: this week, Elsewhere Halloween sells out

verification.note: Elsewhere's own event page states Saturday, October 31, 2026, door time 10:30 PM, Full Venue, 21+, with Major League Djz, SAIDAH, D Stone, Bantu and others; no price listed on the page.

radar.headline: Munk Debate at 92NY: Zakaria vs Deneen
radar.title: America's Liberal Reckoning: A Munk Debate at 92NY (Fareed Zakaria vs Patrick Deneen)
radar.why: A real one-on-one debate with named heavyweights on whether liberalism has failed America, days after the midterms. First Munk in New York, on a Thursday, which is your slot.
radar.book_by: now, the first New York edition will sell

verification.note: Munk Debates' page states Thursday, November 12, 2026, 7:00–8:30 PM ET at the 92nd Street Y with Zakaria vs Deneen, and 92NY's own event page confirms Nov 12, 7 PM ET, In Person; no price shown.

radar.headline: Marc Murphy's one-night pop-up, Nov 12
radar.title: Marc 179 monthly chef pop-up (Marc Murphy)
radar.why: Turns out this isn't an open-ended series to follow, it's a dated Thursday dinner: guest chef, themed four courses, $295 a head. The September edition was a proper German Oktoberfest menu, which tells you they take the theme seriously.
radar.heads_up: The next Marc179 is a one-night beefsteak dinner on Thursday, Nov 12 at 7pm, $295 per person, booked on Resy (another edition follows Dec 11–12).
radar.book_by: seats are limited and it's one night only, so book as soon as the menu posts

verification.note: chefmarcmurphy.com/marc-179 shows the pop-up opens only a few days a month: 'Next Up' is Nov 12 — A Beefsteak by Chef Marc Murphy, Thursday, November 12, 7:00 PM, $295 per person, 21+, with Dec 11–12 after that, so this is not an 'anytime' item.

radar.headline: Masquerade night at Brooklyn Bathhouse
radar.title: Brooklyn Bathhouse Presents: Masquerade Halloween Party
radar.price: tickets on Eventbrite, price not shown on the listing we read
radar.why: Two DJs, saunas, cold plunge and masks, 7 to 11:30pm on Halloween Eve at a small independent bathhouse on Flatbush. Costume night plus cold plunge is three of your things at once.
radar.book_by: Eventbrite, and it's a small house, so don't wait

verification.note: Eventbrite listing from Brooklyn Bathhouse NYC states Friday, October 30, 2026, 7 PM–11:30 PM at Brooklyn Bathhouse, 731 Flatbush Ave, 21+; ticket prices still not displayed on the page.

anytime.headline: Elahni: a sauna speakeasy for two
anytime.title: Elahni sauna and ice bath sessions
anytime.price: $39 for the 30-minute self-guided Reset, $65 for the 70-minute hosted Signature
anytime.why: Small semi-private Finnish sauna and plunge room in Manhattan, $39 for a 30-minute self-guided round or $65 for a 70-minute hosted one. No scene, no chain energy, and you can actually talk to the person running it. The weeknight version of a full bathhouse day.

verification.note: Elahni's site lists The Reset, 30 min self-guided, $39 per seat and The Signature, 70 min hosted, $65 per seat (plus a $130 private room option), by reservation only — it is an ongoing bookable place, not a dated event.

anytime.headline: ZickZack and the German underground, free
anytime.title: Too Much Is Better Than Too Little: Alfred Hilsberg, ZickZack & the Invention of the German Underground
anytime.why: The Alfred Hilsberg show is at Various/Artists, not the Goethe building, and it's free Thursday through Sunday, 3pm to 8pm. The label that effectively invented the German post-punk underground, laid out in a record shop gallery. Twenty minutes of your time before dinner in Manhattan.
anytime.heads_up: The exhibition is at Various/Artists, 19 Essex St on the Lower East Side, open Thu–Sun 3–8pm and closing Nov 7 — not at the Goethe-Institut.

verification.note: Goethe-Institut New York's event page (event_id 27324564) lists the Hilsberg/ZickZack exhibition as running Thu 10/08–Sat 11/07/2026 at Various/Artists, 19 Essex St, free, Thursday–Sunday 3–8pm, so the Gramercy venue in the draft is wrong.

family.headline: The Q Brothers do hip-hop for one-year-olds
family.title: The Q Brothers: Hip Hop for Families
family.why: Improvised hip-hop at Brooklyn Bowl with Jeff Ellis of Freestyle Love Supreme, a DJ-led dance party and free ice cream. Doors at 11, show at 11:45, all ages, kids one and under free. Real venue, real music, and you can hand her a shaker and still enjoy the set.
family.heads_up: The show starts at 11:45am, not noon.
family.invite_text: Saturday there's a hip-hop family show at Brooklyn Bowl, doors 11 and the set starts at 11:45. Let's take her and get lunch in Williamsburg after.

verification.note: Brooklyn Bowl's own event page states Saturday, October 24th, 2026, Doors 11:00 AM / Show 11:45 AM, all ages, at Brooklyn Bowl, 61 Wythe Ave (Rock and Roll Playhouse presents The Q Brothers); no price shown.

notes: The Deutsches Haus talk I had in here sold out before we sent, so the German slot is the free Schlingensief trilogy at Goethe instead. Marc Murphy's pop-up turned out to be a dated Nov 12 dinner at $295 a head, so it moved to the radar, and last week's Nutcracker reminder still stands.
